user.title: Migraine Tracker
user.description: Enter the base URL of your Migraine Tracker, for example http://migraine-tracker:8097. The integration periodically reads GET /api/status. If the tracker sits behind an authenticating reverse proxy, also enter the Authorization header value it expects.

data_description.authorization: Sent verbatim as the Authorization header. Leave empty when the tracker or its proxy requires no authentication.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Migraine Tracker
reconfigure.description: Update the base URL of the tracker. The URL is validated with a single GET of /api/status before it is saved.

data_description.authorization: Leave empty to keep the stored header. Enter a value only to replace it.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the tracker. Check the URL and that the tracker is reachable from Home Assistant.
error.invalid_response: The tracker returned a response that is not a valid apiVersion 1 status document.
error.unsupported_api_version: The tracker does not support API version 1. Update the tracker and try again.
error.unauthorized: The tracker or its reverse proxy rejected the request (401 or 403). Check the Authorization header.
error.invalid_url: Enter the base URL only: an http or https URL without credentials, query string, or fragment, and without the /api/status path.
error.invalid_authorization: The Authorization header contains a character that cannot be sent in an HTTP header (such as a line break or unsupported Unicode). Remove it and try again.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Migraine Tracker entry is allowed.

init.title: Migraine Tracker options
init.description: Choose how often the tracker is polled and manage the optional Authorization header.

data_description.scan_interval: Between 15 and 3600 seconds. Values outside that range are clamped.
data_description.authorization: Leave empty to keep the stored header. Enter a value only to replace it.
data_description.clear_authorization: Deliberately deletes the stored header. Takes precedence over the field above.

error.invalid_authorization: The Authorization header contains a character that cannot be sent in an HTTP header (such as a line break or unsupported Unicode). Remove it and try again.
